name: critique-pi-v1
notes: The Pi SDK and Verify runner are baked into the image; jobs must not install Pi dynamically.
Pi resource discovery is rooted in /opt/critique/pi/agent so cloned repositories cannot auto-load .pi extensions, packages, or settings.
CritiqueCode adds plan-specific thinking, policy middleware, focused checks, and evidence recording through the Pi SDK; activity units are telemetry, not a small interaction cap.
